# Geoffrey Serdar, Lake Minnetonka Realtor

> Geoffrey Serdar is a licensed Minnesota real estate agent with Serdar+Partners at Compass. He works with buyers and sellers around Lake Minnetonka, in the west metro (including Chanhassen, Victoria and Carver County) and in Minneapolis. He works by service area and does not list a street address. Phone: 952-258-3100. Website: https://geoffreyserdar.com

This site has one page per Lake Minnetonka town, local guides, short explainer topics, a weekly closed-sales page and seller tools. Estate and probate home sales are covered on a separate site, Lake Minnetonka Probate.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://geoffreyserdar.com/): who Geoffrey is and how to reach him
- [Lake Minnetonka homes](https://geoffreyserdar.com/lake-minnetonka-homes/): buying and selling around the lake
- [What sold around Lake Minnetonka this week](https://geoffreyserdar.com/lake-minnetonka-weekly/): weekly closed sales by town
